description: Address 8 security and correctness issues found during semantic code review: unsalted password hashing, deterministic encryption, admin account race condition, port counter reset, missing Secure cookie flag, disconnected supervisor check, orphan rows on app delete, and CDN dependency for htmx.
steps: Replace unsalted SHA-256 password hashing with PBKDF2-SHA256 using a random salt and high iteration count
Add random 16-byte nonce to crypto encrypt, prepend to ciphertext, adjust decrypt to strip nonce prefix
Fix admin account creation race by using atomic INSERT with WHERE NOT EXISTS
Initialize next_port from SELECT MAX(port) FROM apps at startup instead of compile-time constant
Add Secure flag to session cookie format
Wire vekd_supervisor_check into the event loop via a repeating timer
Add cascading deletes for env_vars, events, releases when an app is deleted
Inline htmx source as a static C string instead of loading from CDN
acceptance_criteria: Password hashes include a salt prefix and use iterative hashing
Encrypting the same plaintext twice produces different ciphertexts
Admin creation uses a single atomic SQL statement
next_port is derived from MAX(port) in the database on startup
Session cookie includes the Secure flag
Supervisor check is wired to a timer in the event loop
Deleting an app also removes related env_vars, events, and releases rows
No external CDN references remain in the HTML templates
verification: Run 'make vekd' and confirm clean compilation
Run 'build/test_vekd_db' and confirm all tests pass
